method: Sequential inspection of all 100 exported frames on three full-frame panels, with contact-sheet follow-up for uncertain anatomy and locomotion.
notes: Identity, outfit, limb completeness, action phases and facing inspected against supplied source.
Walk/backwalk are experimental locomotion; physical foot phases and loop endpoint continuity inspected; silhouette overlap alone is not an anatomy failure.
KO ends horizontal, turn ends facing left, other actions face right.
Head spans are approximate manual estimates.
Replacement kick passes chronological guard/chamber/extension/retraction, no premature extension frame.
